summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-typescript preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as an ESLint TypeScript configuration but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (github.com/oven-sh/bun) and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle starting with `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing shuffled constant arrays and a rotator decode routine. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with hex-prefixed identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x19328d`) and string-map dispatch typical of obfuscator.io output. An ESLint config has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or a large opaque compiled payload; the alternate runtime is used to run code that Node-based scanners will not execute. Installing the package results in the obfuscated bundle running on the installer's host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
